title.narrative: Cote d'Ivoire Readiness 2020

description.narrative: The readiness will support the elaboration of multi-annual work programme for (BNI and FIRCA) national accredited entities; Conduct pre-feasibility study in best financial vehicle to support private sector development; Elaboration of the concept note with key stakeholders on financial vehicle, elaborate manual on Green Building Minimum Compliance System and Train financial institutions and insurance companies in Green investment and their potentiality
This Readiness grant aims to strengthen Cote d’Ivoire’s capacity to achieve its NDC target on reducing CO2 emissions from the construction and building sector.
